record.original_question: Study the dynamics and bifurcations of systems with a small number of point vortices on manifolds such as half-planes, quarter-planes, hemispheres, quarter-spheres, disks, tori, cylinders, and half-cylinders.

evidence.quote: Problem 28. Study in detail the motion and bifurcations of a small number of vortices on vari- ous manifolds: half- and quarter-plane, hemi- and quarter-sphere, disk, torus, cylinder and half- cylinder, etc. Of particular interest is the study of point vortices on non-orientable manifolds, which started only recently, see e.g. [8, 9, 139, 133] for a description of the motion and bifurcations of a small number of vortices on such non-orientable surfaces as the Möbius band, projective plane and the Klein bottle.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is broad and ongoing. While point-vortex dynamics on individual domains (disk, sphere, torus, cylinder, Möbius band, etc.) have been studied in many works, a complete classification of motions and bifurcations of small numbers of vortices across all these manifolds remains an active research program with many cases still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Point vortices on surfaces (survey activity)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem posed as an open research direction; partial results exist for specific manifolds but no complete solution.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as an open research program.
